name: zvideo_blur_region_horizontal
description: zVideo::buff_BlurRegionHorizontal applies the 16bpp horizontal weighted blur over the clamped FX surface region.
known_limits: Tier S remains blocked in the zVideo FX blur cluster. VC5SP3 11.00.7022 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 COFF byte compare for 0x48e870 currently fails with 192 unmasked mismatches after masking 40 relocation bytes and trimming 10 VC NOP bytes; BN and VC object bodies are both 400 bytes.

Same-session rbMask alias-removal, bottom/count ordering, natural tap-expression, and row-carry source-shape probes kept behavior passing and improved the prior 218-mismatch compact-body baseline, but byte equivalence is still blocked by stack/local ordering and pointer-loop codegen drift.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x48e870 validates null/full-surface bounds, rect clipping to left >= 1, inclusive y range, and the 1:2:1 horizontal RGB565-safe weighted average into scratch before copying back.
Native smoke zvideo_blur_region_horizontal_smoke verifies the clamped horizontal blur writes x in [left,right) and preserves untouched pixels.
